claims.claim: Prospective PRIMARY issuance requires the original admitted owner and lease, an independently authenticated Runtime service peer, and exact TASK/admission/RUN/profile/candidate/tree/artifact/RESULT/EVIDENCE and original raw metadata bindings.
Read-only inspection correlates authenticated Runtime and REVIEW ingress receipts by exact source pins while keeping recorded verdict separate from semantic Reviewer authority.
The protected broker enforces caller role, App identity, operation namespace, exact ref/CAS, reservation binding and non-replay. Its RPC returns neither private keys nor installation tokens.

Canonical bytes and raw remain local; new public exports use opaque locators and safe summaries. Source receipts carry bounded metadata, and authorized independent raw comparisons check original digest and size.

Affected owner writes retain immutable-ref creation CAS, main reservation/CAS and shared Control-to-Runtime lease semantics. Replay recognizes coherent legacy or new export bytes without rewriting existing artifact refs.

Isolated adversarial test definitions cover forged owners, wrong writers, mismatched pins and objects, swapped raw, stale refs, replay, unauthenticated IPC, TLS service impersonation and missing credentials or permissions.

The Stage 2 contract enumerates creation and update namespace coverage and requires separate credential setup, positive/negative live smoke and Human activation authority. No ruleset activation or bypass API was added.

Frozen schemas, legacy owner-authority flags and verification planning/cache code remain unchanged. Unsupported, historical and preterminal provenance remains UNKNOWN/BLOCK, with no proof-reuse or lifecycle authority granted by source inspection.
